title: fix(ui): match agent skills panel filter against NFC queries
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Agents Skills filtering misses canonically equivalent Unicode: an NFC query cannot find an NFD skill name, and the reverse also fails, producing a false “0 shown / No skills found.”

## User Impact

Operators can find real workspace skills regardless of composed or decomposed spelling. Raw queries, displayed names, skill keys, paths and Gateway payloads remain unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

Apply lowercase-then-NFC only to the prepared row comparison text and filter memo in the existing `panels-skills.tsx` owner. Keep its prepared-text caching, substring matching and original skill objects. No global normalizer or server/storage rewrite.

huwei-xydt's commits and the carried7c5b62 history are retained. Integrating current main removes the already-merged #188883 Review files from the introduced diff without reverting them. Final diff: only Agents Skills production and its existing browser tests. The new mock-Gateway e2e and duplicate standalone case are consolidated into existing retained-control/filter-clear and scope scenarios. Production **0 net lines (2/2)**, tests **0 net lines (8/8)**; no allowance.

## Evidence

[Real built-Gateway / filesystem / Chromium proof and replay commands](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/189276#issuecomment-6543690531)

Final head `559d77b3956764185c3dc6153839910f856a690b`; frozen main `dfd4904312e87674d468d89232180973859e26e0`. Independently built matching Gateway/UI in secretless Node24.22.1 Linux Docker, real Chromium156, native `skills.status` discovery of actual workspace SKILL.md files. No mocked Gateway inventory or model turn.

- NFC query→NFD name and NFD query→NFC name each fail **twice on main** and succeed **twice on candidate**.
- Same-form Unicode, mixed-case ASCII, negative and clear controls pass on both refs.
- Raw input and rendered title/toggle labels preserve their original code points; native name/key bytes and file contents are unchanged. Filtering makes zero Gateway requests or config/skill writes.
- HTTP-served entry hashes match built files and differ across refs. Both Gateways exit0.
- **15/15 browser tests pass**; exact final tests on main give **11 pass /4 expected canonical-matching failures**. Builds, scoped type-aware lint, formatting and whitespace pass.

Production was built/proven at fdcbb92; final559d only spells test fixture forms explicitly, with identical production and rerun final checks. Task-only synthetic token/key and fixture-only device-auth bypass; no authentication or inference claim.

### Before: NFC query misses the real NFD skill
![Before NFC query misses NFD name](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9c838541-789e-4287-a1a7-9b4344f22f16)

### After: same query finds the unchanged NFD skill
![After NFC query matches original NFD name](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5296d449-c8ef-4b11-be6e-855c966cc927)

The evidence comment also includes the reverse-direction before/after pair.

## Merge Danger

Two-way door: reverting restores the previous comparison without changing persisted data. Blast radius is the Agents Skills local filter only. Selection identities, configuration, permission gates and server echoes are unchanged; no migration or public contract change.
